resolutions.researcher_notes: GEM Status = construction. The original current_ref (iraqieconomists.net PDF) returns HTTP 200 but the document does NOT mention this pipeline (verifier fails on 'Rumaila'; WebFetch confirms no Faiha/North-Rumaila pipeline content) — so it is not a usable source for this row and is dropped. New corroboration: (1) attaqa.net (Iraqi energy outlet 'منصة الطاقة', 7 Apr 2026) reports Oil Projects Company (شركة المشاريع النفطية) BEGAN implementing a new gas pipeline pushing gas toward the North Rumaila liquids-separation (NGL) plant via the compressor site near Yamama station (محطة اليمامة, a Faiha-field reservoir): 20-inch dia, 55 mmcf/d, Phase-1 hot-tapping tie-in + Phase-2 3 km extension, target 15-day completion — i.e. actively under construction. (2) al-mirbad.com (8 May 2025) explicitly names 'مشروع الفيحاء' (the Faiha project) gas lines being commissioned/inaugurated ('تدشين خطي غاز') mid-May 2025. Tier MEDIUM not high: only attaqa is substantive, and it corroborates construction toward North Rumaila but does not literally name 'Faiha'; al-mirbad names Faiha but is a thin video-snippet page and a separate/earlier event. TIMING FLAG for review: al-mirbad's May-2025 'inauguration' vs attaqa's Apr-2026 'just-started new line' suggest GEM's single row may bundle multiple phases — status could be past pure 'construction' for the earlier line. NOTE: the sotaliraq.com (14 Apr 2026) piece feeding the same North Rumaila NGL plant is a DIFFERENT project (Bin Umar / أبن عمر gas investment), deliberately NOT used to avoid conflating two pipelines.

GEM Location: Start = Basrah, Iraq; End = North Rumaila oil field, Basrah, Iraq. attaqa.net (7 Apr 2026) confirms the pipeline pushes gas toward 'معمل فصل السوائل في الرميلة الشمالية' (the North Rumaila liquids-separation/NGL plant) via the compressor site near 'محطة اليمامة' (Yamama station) — all in Basra governorate — strongly corroborating the North-Rumaila / Basrah END and Basrah location. The Faiha START is supported by (a) al-mirbad (8 May 2025) naming the 'Faiha project' (الفيحاء) gas lines and (b) the Yamama-station link, since Yamama is one of the Faiha field's reservoirs (Al-Yamama/Mishrif/Al-Zubair per baghdadtoday/zagrosnews coverage of the July-2024 Faiha CPF opening). Tier MEDIUM: the North Rumaila/Basrah end is well corroborated by attaqa; the Faiha start rests on the Yamama-field inference plus al-mirbad rather than an explicit 'Faiha → North Rumaila' statement in one source. No contradiction with GEM values.
